headline: El Molino Residential Development / FAMM Arquitectura
context: El Molino is a residential development located in Playa Pelada , Nosara, Costa Rica. Designed by FAMM Arquitectura, the project was conceived as a compact coastal community organized around climate, vegetation, and outdoor living.
